events.query: directional light shadows fog exponential camera orbit

summary: I wrote src/main.ts. It builds a 260×260 ground plane and 10,000 instanced objects in three instanced nodes: 8,000 trunks, 8,000 canopies and 2,000 rocks. Positions come from a fixed-seed LCG (seed 12345). Canopies and rocks get per-instance HSL colours on a white base material. The scene has one shadow-casting directional light, a hemisphere fill light, and exponential fog (`effects.fog`, density 0.0045). The camera is `camera.orbit` with `autoRotate`, placed at [0, 85, 130] to keep the whole forest in view. `window.__EVAL_READY__` is set after `app.ready()` and two animation frames. `typecheck` passes. I did not run `vite build` or render the scene, so the look, shadow coverage and fog strength are unchecked. Also, `__EVAL_READY__` is set after two `requestAnimationFrame` ticks rather than inside the engine's own render loop, so it doesn't strictly confirm the first frame was drawn.
